chk.text: Marrow-Gnawer unites three nezumi gangs by slaying their leaders in a single night, assassinating three makiba including his brother, and becomes a makiba commanding the largest warrior group in Takenuma Swamp.

Uramon captures and tortures him over his dealings with the soratami, and later Toshi tricks Marrow-Gnawer and Kiku into the Hyozan Reckoners, so that bound by the oath they help him neutralize Uramon and steal her Shadow Gate.
At Minamo Hidetsugu nearly kills Toshi and Kiku, so Marrow-Gnawer stabs his eye, saving them but invoking the hyozan curse.
Toshi ends Marrow-Gnawer's suffering with an axe.
